about_pullquote: We started this because we were tired of seeing families charged rip-off prices for emergency repairs.
about_para_1: Slough Plumbing And Heating has been serving homes and businesses across Slough for over 18 years. We began as a small family operation focused on honest, fair pricing for emergency callouts — and we've grown by doing exactly that. Our engineers are Gas Safe Registered and carry the parts needed to fix most problems on the spot.
about_para_2: We've built a reputation for turning up on time, fixing the job right, and charging what we quote — no hidden extras. Our customers come back because they know we'll treat their home with respect and sort the problem without the nonsense. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler replacement, you get the same level of care.
reviews_heading: What Slough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe at 2am on a Saturday. Called Slough Plumbing and they were here in 45 minutes. Brilliant response. The engineer knew exactly what he was doing, fixed it properly, and the price was fair. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Got a new boiler installed last month. The lads were professional, explained everything clearly, and left the place spotless. They even tested the heating and showed me how to use the controls. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Linda C.

reviews.text: My radiators kept going cold. Called them out and they identified the problem straight away — a stuck valve. Fixed in under an hour. Never tried to upsell me on work I didn't need. That's why I use them again and again.
reviews.author: David R.
